## User Story

As a delivery owner
I want to publish the original transition comment only from current verified intent because existing local consistency and comment corrections still need bounded integration and composed verification
So that stale, malformed or interrupted comment effects cannot masquerade as transition completion

## Scope

New bounded repair child of sibling epic1918 under1847. Original1855 retains the already implemented code and historical timeline; complete only this remaining repair over that checkpoint. Published baseline14f6c5589724e9d2a33c2353c19f0c793bfe6033 and preserved58-WIP/2544-source checkpoint are distinct. Qualify reused code and tests on this child HEAD; do not copy old test receipts or treat local WIP evidence as published CI.

Each repair owns its actual source entrypoints, focused positive/negative/fault tests and required ordinary regressions. Record inherited failure ownership explicitly; a passing scoped repair is not globally green CI. No tests/budgets/guards/required delivery checks are waived. The whole original protection contract and complete/vertical assertions remain owned by1918 until final integration. Node.js scripts and Markdown only; no compiled native binaries/addons.

Estimate only incremental authoring, diagnosis and review using already implemented work; do not charge prior implementation again or use passive CI walltime as productive effort. Any forecast >=24 must split again before continuation. No board estimate or completion proof is inherited at creation.

Capability: publish the original transition comment only from current verified intent. Need: existing local consistency and comment corrections still need bounded integration and composed verification. Value: stale, malformed or interrupted comment effects cannot masquerade as transition completion.

Remaining delivery steps:
- Reuse the already-tested current consistency/read/result-custody closure and step16 intent/effect/readback implementation.
- Qualify the original comment positive, history and public negative cases on the new integrated HEAD.
- Own step16 and consistency/comment boundaries; steps1–15 remain on1912 and17–18 on1913.

Source review surfaces:
- `scripts/task-tracker/lib/criteria-revision/stage-execution.mjs`
- `scripts/task-tracker/lib/criteria-revision/source-correction.mjs`
- `scripts/task-tracker/lib/criteria-revision/store.mjs`
- `scripts/task-tracker/lib/move-state/transition-commit.mjs`

Targeted verifiers are delivery obligations; add the focused file where absent rather than fabricate executable proof at hydration:
- `scripts/tests/integration/task-tracker/lib/criteria-revision-consistency-comment.test.mjs`

### Dependency and remaining-work WBS

Direct native blockers: #1912. No1855Done dependency; original1855 waits for1918 completion.

- Integrate exact already-tested consistency/comment closure: 1h.
- Qualify positive/history/current-negative cases on integrated HEAD: 2h.
- Public/ordinary/source-contract review: 1h.

Prospective incremental estimate: 4 human hours; excludes prior implementation and passive CI time. All revised forecasts >=24 require another split.

## Story Origin

- **kind**: code
- **parent**: #1918
- **source**: Human authorized remaining-scope repair children and all-child Ready for Planning hydration on2026-10-08 America/Chicago.
- **delivery-boundary**: comment16: Complete consistency checks and transition-comment custody.
- **prior-implementation**: Preserve1855 published14f6 and58-WIP source/evidence checkpoint; this child estimates and completes only incremental repair.
- **reason-for-child**: Split review boundaries before a forecast reaches24h; place independently verifiable CI fixes first and retain original full contract on1918.

## Pickup Directive — MANDATORY, DO NOT SKIP

> Follow: `.ai-task-manager/templates/pickup-directive.md`

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Original current consistency and comment16 execute under current source, request, resource, lock and persisted-intent custody; public source/prototype/accessor/return-custody negatives produce no unauthorized effects. <!-- aitm-verified vc-list="vc:1" -->
- [ ] The positive prefix through16 and all comment intent/effect/readback fail-before/fail-after/history cases retain exact durable facts; history construction alone does not prove a native retry. <!-- aitm-verified vc-list="vc:1" -->
- [ ] Ordinary comment behavior and remaining whole-transition tests remain intact; no complete transition is claimed before terminal composition. <!-- aitm-verified vc-list="vc:1" -->

## Definition of Done
<!--
Each item below MUST be individually verified by running the declared
verifier. Do not bulk-check. Do not preemptively check. The visible checkbox
is the sign-off; the hidden `aitm-dod-evidence:<key>` marker is the evidence
trail. `/task check` refuses to tick a stampable Functional DoD item without
its marker; run `/task dod-stamp <key>` to produce one. The two derived keys
(`acs`, `checkboxes`) are auto-stamped by `/task close` from the body itself.
See `skill/shared/rules/functional-dod.md` for the full contract.

Lifecycle items are verified during Review. Housekeeping items are finalized
during Close; their separate headings make the owning workflow phase explicit.

Kind-aware items (#681): append a `dod:kinds` HTML-comment annotation to scope
an item to a set of issue kinds. `exclude="spike,research"` renders the item for
every kind EXCEPT those listed; `include="code"` renders it only for the listed
kinds; an item with no annotation applies to every kind (the default). The
`tests` item is excluded for the no-code kinds `spike` and `research`, which ship
findings rather than code and would otherwise carry a test-suite DoD item and a
`npm run test:all` verification command they can never satisfy. Filtering happens
at render time in `preflight-issue.mjs`; a filtered-out item is simply absent, so
no phantom evidence marker is ever required for it.

Diff-decides for `docs-only` (#865): the `tests` item deliberately does NOT
static-exclude `docs-only`. A `docs-only` issue can quietly touch code, so the
kind alone must not launder it out of the suite. Instead the `tests` item is
dropped only when the render is `--kind docs-only` AND a supplied
`--changed-paths-file` proves the `trunk...HEAD` diff is documentation-only
(default-deny: any unclassified/empty/mixed diff keeps the item). "The kind
declares, the diff decides."
-->
